scraped.scraped_description: Parti is a digital platform enabling citizens to participate directly in local governance through proposal submission, voting, and collaborative deliberation with municipal governments.

name: Parti
tagline: 함께 만드는 워킹그룹, 빠띠 카누 (Together Making Working Groups, Parti Canu) - A platform for connecting people with similar interests loosely and collaborating through shared documents, voting, and surveys
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Reliance on Korean language and local government partnerships

news_articles.headline: South Korea's Parti Platform Expands Civic Participation Across 50+ Municipalities
Digital Democracy in Action: Parti's Role in Local Governance
How Parti is Transforming Citizen Engagement in Korean Cities

academic_citations: Park, J. & Kim, S. (2023). Digital Participatory Democracy in East Asia: The Parti Platform Case Study. Journal of E-Democracy and Open Government.

policy_outcomes.description: Parti platform integrated into municipal budgeting processes in Seoul and Busan, enabling direct citizen input on public spending priorities
Increased citizen participation in local government decision-making, with over 200,000 registered users submitting proposals across 50+ municipalities
Adoption by Incheon Metropolitan City for participatory budgeting process, allocating 5 billion won through citizen voting

documented_limitations: Primarily focused on South Korean context
Sustainability dependent on continued government partnerships
failure_modes: Low sustained engagement in some municipalities
Challenges in scaling beyond Korean-language interface
curation_criteria: Community-driven moderation with local government oversight
contributor_governance: Open contribution model with community review process
